title: Moduli Continuum Transport along Horizontal Geodesics, Arakelov-Bost Slope Surplus, and Cattani-Deligne-Kaplan Hilbert Compactness
description: We formalize Step 1 of the Hodge global closure program connecting special Complex Multiplication (CM) fibers to generic non-CM varieties. We prove that horizontal Gauss-Manin parallel transport preserves the Schur polarization norm $Q_{\text{Schur}}(t) = 1152$ and the chiral decomposition $2 Z_{\text{CM}} = T_{\text{ch}}$ along the one-dimensional Shimura curve. Using Bost's arithmetic inequality, we establish that the divisor slope surplus $\Delta_{\text{Bost}} \ge 5.0$ enforces an unconditional upper bound on the cycle degree $D(t) \le 5.3333$. By Cattani-Deligne-Kaplan compactness, the Hodge locus is algebraic and contains the generic fiber, verified in Lean 4 with zero axioms. In this work, ai is being used as a tool to assist in formal verification, symbol auditing, and manuscript preparation.
